card.name: Inside Asian personal names
card.fires_on: The last syllable of a romanized East or Southeast Asian personal name, such as Chinese, Vietnamese or Cambodian, especially a given name split into pieces. It appears in citations, news and history text.

modes.label: Chinese name ending
modes.description: Final or middle syllable of a romanized Chinese name of an author, scholar or scientist.
modes.example: Authors: Fu Liguo (傅立<<国>> Fu Li-kuo) , Yu

modes.label: Other Asian names
modes.description: Final syllable of a Vietnamese or Cambodian name or place name.

card.writes: Promotes odd Chinese-character and name fragments and suppresses code-like terms, so it adds little clear output.
card.plain: It fires on the closing piece of an Asian person's name split into syllables.
